seed.claim_statement: On a fixed synthetic 2000-example split, pruning 20 percent of Model A weights or quantizing them to 8 bits loses at most 1 percentage point of accuracy against unchanged Model A.
seed.paper_title: Synthetic accuracy study of weight pruning and quantization

payload.conditions: Same Model A and evaluation split; prune 20 percent of weights with mask seed 42, or quantize weights to 8 bits.
payload.method: Count correct classifications for unchanged and modified Model A on the same synthetic 2000-example split.

metric.comparison: At most 1 percentage point loss relative to unchanged Model A on the same split.
metric.definition: 100 times (unchanged correct count minus modified correct count) divided by 2000.
metric.name: classification accuracy loss

payload.question: Do 20 percent weight pruning and 8-bit weight quantization keep Model A within 1 percentage point of its unchanged accuracy?
